episodes.title: The Black Legend, Native Americans, and Spaniards
episodes.description: John teaches you about early Spanish explorers, settlements, and what happened when they didn't get along with the indigenous people.

episodes.title: When is Thanksgiving? Colonizing America
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about the (English) colonies in what is now the United States.

episodes.title: The Natives and the English
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about relations between the early English colonists and the native people they encountered in the New World.

episodes.title: The Quakers, the Dutch, and the Ladies
episodes.description: Explore Dutch New York, Quaker Pennsylvania, colonial social hierarchies, and the treatment of women and Indigenous peoples.

episodes.title: The Seven Years War and the Great Awakening
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about the beginnings of the American Revolution in a video titled The Seven Years War.

episodes.title: Taxes & Smuggling – Prelude to Revolution
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about the roots of the American Revolution.

episodes.title: Who Won the American Revolution?
episodes.description: Compare Revolutionary War strategies and battles, then examine how the revolution’s benefits differed across American social groups.

episodes.title: The Constitution, the Articles, and Federalism
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about the United States Constitution.

episodes.title: Where US Politics Came From
episodes.description: Trace the emergence of American political parties through competing Federalist and Democratic-Republican visions of government and the economy.

episodes.title: Thomas Jefferson & His Democracy
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about the founding father and third president of the United States, Thomas Jefferson.

episodes.title: The War of 1812
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about the War of 1812.

episodes.title: The Market Revolution
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about the Market Revolution.

episodes.title: Slavery
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about America's "peculiar institution," slavery.

episodes.title: Age of Jackson
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about the presidency of Andrew Jackson.

episodes.title: 19th Century Reforms
episodes.description: Explore nineteenth-century American reform, including utopian communities, religious revival, and abolitionism.

episodes.title: Women in the 19th Century
episodes.description: Explore women’s reform activism, the Seneca Falls Convention, and campaigns for suffrage, fair pay, and equal rights in nineteenth-century America.

episodes.title: War & Expansion
episodes.description: Examine the Mexican-American War, western territorial expansion, the California Gold Rush, and the renewed conflicts over slavery that followed.

episodes.title: The Election of 1860 & the Road to Disunion
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about the election of 1860.

episodes.title: Battles of the Civil War
episodes.description: In this episode of Crash Course US History, John Green lists a whole lot of the battles of the US Civil War.

episodes.title: The Civil War, Part 1
episodes.description: Examine Civil War causes, soldiers’ motivations, and the advantages and strategies that helped the Union defeat the Confederacy.

episodes.title: The Civil War, Part 2
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you how the Civil War played a large part in making the United States the country that it is today.

episodes.title: Reconstruction and 1876
episodes.description: You'll learn about the Freedman's Bureau, the 14th and 15th amendments, and the disastrous election of 1876.

episodes.title: The Industrial Economy
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about the Industrial Economy that arose in the United States after the Civil War.

episodes.title: Westward Expansion
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about the Wild, Wild, West, which as it turns out, wasn't as wild as it seemed in the movies.

episodes.title: Growth, Cities, and Immigration
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about the massive immigration to the United States during the late 19th and early 20th centuries.

episodes.title: Gilded Age Politics
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about the Gilded Age and its politics.

episodes.title: The Progressive Era
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about the Progressive Era in the United States.

episodes.title: American Imperialism
episodes.description: Explore American imperial expansion through the Spanish-American War, overseas colonial possessions, and the annexation of Hawaii.

episodes.title: Progressive Presidents
episodes.description: The presidents most associated with the Progressive Era are Theodore Roosevelt, William Taft, and Woodrow Wilson.

episodes.title: America in World War I
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about American involvement in World War I, which at the time was called the Great War.

episodes.title: Women’s Suffrage
episodes.description: Explore women’s suffrage, employment, legal rights, and reform activism during the Progressive Era.

episodes.title: The Roaring 20’s
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about the United States in the 1920s.

episodes.title: The Great Depression
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about the Great Depression.

episodes.title: The New Deal
episodes.description: John will teach you about some of the most effective and best-known programs of the New Deal.

episodes.title: World War II, Part 1
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about World War II, a subject so big, it takes up two episodes.

episodes.title: World War II, Part 2 – The Homefront
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about World War II, as it was lived on the home front.

episodes.title: The Cold War
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about the Cold War, which was the decades-long conflict between the USA and the USSR.

episodes.title: The Cold War in Asia
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about the Cold War as it unfolded in Asia.

episodes.title: Civil Rights and the 1950s
episodes.description: In this episode of Crash Course US History, John Green teaches you about the early days of the Civil Rights movement.

episodes.title: The 1960s in America
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about a time of relative tumult in the United States, the 1960s.

episodes.title: The Rise of Conservatism
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about the rise of the conservative movement in United States politics.

episodes.title: Ford, Carter, and the Economic Malaise
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about the economic malaise that beset the United States in the 1970s.

episodes.title: The Reagan Revolution
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about what is often called the Reagan Era.

episodes.title: George HW Bush and the End of the Cold War
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about the end of the Cold War and the presidency of George H.W. Bush.

episodes.title: The Clinton Years, or the 1990s
episodes.description: In which John Green teaches you about the United States as it was in the 1990s.

episodes.title: Terrorism, War, and Bush 43
episodes.description: John will teach you about Bush's domestic policies like tax cutting and education reform, and he'll get into the wars in Afghanistan and Iraq.

episodes.title: Obamanation
episodes.description: Examine the end of George W. Bush’s presidency and Barack Obama’s early administration, including the stimulus and Affordable Care Act.
